captions.detailed: A solar hydrogen-alpha refractor telescope mounted on a dark grey alt-azimuth mount and tripod. The telescope assembly features a golden-brass colored main tube with a red-banded etalon filter at the front end, connected via a dark grey prismatic focuser draw-tube to a small eyepiece. The mount consists of a vertical arm that supports the telescope on a revolute altitude joint, and rotates continuously on an azimuth bearing atop a thin black tripod base.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a solar hydrogen-alpha refractor telescope on an alt-azimuth tripod mount. The telescope should feature a brass-colored main tube, a red-banded etalon filter at the objective end, and a black eyepiece tube. It should be mounted on a dual-axis articulation system: a continuous azimuth rotation joint on the tripod head and a revolute altitude tilt joint for the telescope body.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod base using three angled cylinders for legs and a central vertical post. Build the alt-az mount using a series of stacked cylinders and boxes to form the rotating base and the vertical arm. Model the telescope body using concentric cylinders for the main tube, etalon filter (colored red), and eyepiece draw-tube, joined by a prismatic block representing the focuser. Define three joints: a continuous joint for the azimuth axis, a revolute joint for the altitude axis, and a prismatic joint for the focuser draw-tube.
